subject: [Bakery] ⚠️ SOLD OUT: ${item_name}
body:
Hello ${admin_name},

The University Bakery Shop has just run out of stock for ${item_name}.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                  SOLD OUT NOTIFICATION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Item:          ${item_name}
Category:      ${category}
Last sold at:  ${triggered_at}

This item is no longer available for purchase — customers will see it disabled in the Shop until you restock it.

Next steps:
  • Open the Inventory tab in the Bakery Shop
  • Check the supplier and reorder rule for this item
  • Either raise a new purchase order or adjust stock manually after restocking

— University Bakery Shop
